name: find_lucide_icons
description: Recovery-only tool for unsupported Lucide icon warnings. Use this only after create_section or edit_part returns a WARNING about invalid/unsupported Lucide icon names. Do not call this before normal HTML generation or as a general icon-planning step.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Invalid icon name or loose icon intent from a Lucide WARNING. Supports multiple searches separated by pipe, for example lock-icon | file lock | secure. Use pipe-separated searches when a warning names multiple invalid icons.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum ICON suggestions per search. Values are clamped to 1-12.

output.description: Plain text grouped Lucide recovery results. Each SEARCH lists exact ICON names that can be used as data-lucide values.
